patterns.note: Content is presented in a highly minimalist, centered column on a dark background, emphasizing vertical flow and ample negative space around text blocks.
An extreme typographic contrast is used, featuring a large, ornate, custom display typeface for the hero identity, paired with a clean, understated sans-serif for all body and descriptive text.
A stark black and white base palette is used for text and background, with vibrant, iridescent blues, purples, and pinks introduced solely through the dynamic 3D WebGL object in the hero.

The hero's custom typographic element and 3D object scale down significantly and parallax upwards, becoming a persistent, smaller header at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, while subsequent content scrolls normally underneath.
Sections are defined by large vertical spacing and distinct text blocks rather than visual dividers or background changes, maintaining a consistent dark canvas.

technique_notes: The hero section prominently features a custom-rendered typographic element combined with a dynamic, interactive 3D crystalline object, both powered by WebGL (specifically Three.js). As the user scrolls, these elements smoothly scale down, parallax upwards, and the 3D object subtly rotates, transitioning into a sticky, compact header that remains visible while other content scrolls beneath it.

Body content is structured as a single, centered text column with generous line spacing and paragraph breaks, ensuring high readability against the dark background and directing focus to the interactive hero and concise information.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, decorative hero text (~8-10x body) with small, consistent sans-serif body text and slightly larger, bolded labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially in the hero and between major text blocks, creating a sense of luxury and focus on individual elements.

standout: The site's standout feature is its highly distinctive, interactive hero section, which combines custom, ornate typography with a dynamic, WebGL-rendered 3D object that scales and parallaxes to become a persistent header. This creates a unique, memorable brand identity that is both artistic and technically sophisticated.
